meta.title: Subiza — sisitemu isubiza
meta.description: Subiza isubiza telefone yawe n'ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp mu Kinyarwanda. Nomero yawe ntihinduka. Nta karita y'ubwishyu ikenewe.
meta.howDescription: Kode ya telefone imaze imyaka myinshi. Ukanda. Ntidushobora kuyikanda mu mwanya wawe.
meta.pricingTitle: Ibiciro by'imbere muri RWF, na MoMo
meta.pricingDescription: Ibiciro by'igerageza, byubahirizwa muri uyu mwaka. Amafaranga ni ay'imbere, nk'airtime.
meta.securityDescription: Uko Subiza ikoresha ubwihisho, ububiko n'uburenganzira.
meta.aboutDescription: Subiza bisobanura subiza. Byubatswe i Kigali ku bucuruzi buto.
meta.dataDescription: Saba ibyo dufite, ukosore, cyangwa usibe. Nta konti ikenewe.

nav.langNote: Ubwenge bwa Subiza buvugana mu ndimi enye. Urubuga rwa interineti ruri mu Kinyarwanda n'Icyongereza; Igifaransa n'Igiswahili bizaza n'isoko.

chrome.blurb: Isubiza telefone n'ubutumwa by'ubucuruzi buto, mu Kinyarwanda. Kigali, u Rwanda.

hero.title: Nta mukiriya wongera gutakara.
hero.lede: Subiza isubiza telefone yawe n'ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp mu Kinyarwanda, isubiza ibibazo by'abakiriya, ifate ubutumwa, kandi iguhamagare iyo umukiriya akeneye umuntu. Nomero yawe ntihinduka. Nta karita y'ubwishyu ikenewe.
hero.offCode: Uhagarika igihe ushakiye, ukoresheje kode imwe

demo.callIntro: Hamagara iyi nomero ubu. Uzavugana na Subiza nk'uko umukiriya wawe azabigenza.
demo.try1: Mufungura saa zingahe ku wa gatandatu?
demo.try2: Ni angahe ku musatsi? — reba uko isubiza ku giciro
demo.try3: Vuga mu Cyongereza hagati mu kiganiro. Irahindura.
demo.abuse: Iyi ni demo isanzwe ya Subiza — si iyawe. Uzagira iyawe bwite mu minota {minutes} nyuma yo kwiyandikisha.
demo.weIntro: Andika nomero yawe. Telefone yawe izahita ivuza mu masegonda make.
demo.hint: Nomero z'u Rwanda gusa muri iyi demo.
demo.consent: Demo ebyiri kuri nomero ku munsi. Nomero yawe ikoreshwa gusa muri iyi demo kandi igasibwa mu masaha 24 keretse wiyandikishije. Ntabwo izagurishwa.
demo.ringingBody: Fata telefone. Uzavugana na Subiza mu Kinyarwanda.
demo.doneBody: Iyo wiyandikishije ubu, ikiganiro umaze kugira kiba icya mbere muri Subiza yawe — ushobora kureba icyo cyavuzwe cyose.
demo.rateTitle: Iyi nomero yamaze demo ebyiri uyu munsi
demo.rateBody: Ongera ugerageze mu minota {minutes}, cyangwa uhamagare nomero yawe wenyine — iyo nzira ntiyigera ihagarara.
demo.failBody: Ikosa ryacu. Hamagara nomero iri hasi. Turababariye.
demo.notRw: Demo ihamagara nomero z'u Rwanda gusa. Ahubwo duhamagare.
demo.offlineBody: Telefone irakora n'iyo data itariho. Hamagara nomero.

honesty.title: Turi mu igerageza. Dore ibyo dushobora kwerekana n'ibyo tutashobora.
honesty.intro: Amasosiyete menshi y'ubwenge bwa AI yerekana ibirango by'abakiriya batigeze babona. Twebwe ntitubigenza dutyo. Uzumva ubwenge bwacu wenyine, hanyuma ufate icyemezo.
honesty.can1: Isubiza mu Kinyarwanda, ikumva Ikinyarwanda — hamagara nomero iri hejuru
honesty.can4: Ukoresha nomero yawe usanzwe ufite, ukoresheje kode ya telefone
honesty.cant1: Nta bakiriya benshi bafite amateka maremare. Turi mu igerageza kuva 2026.
honesty.cant2: Ibiciro bya nyuma. Turacyapima uko amaminota akoreshwa mu byukuri — reba Ibiciro.
honesty.cant3: WhatsApp yihuse. Meta isaba iminsi y'akazi kugira ngo yemeze ubucuruzi bwawe.
honesty.cant4: Ubushobozi bwo ​​guhamagara abakiriya benshi icyarimwe. Ntabwo tubikora.

hear.title: Ibi ni ibyo umukiriya wawe yumva.
hear.lede: Ntabwo ari menu ya «kanda 1». Ni ijwi risubiza, ryumva, kandi rikamenya igihe rigomba kuguhamagara.
hear.label: Igerageza — si inyandiko y'umukiriya wishyura.
hear.line: Basaba abantu umunani ku wa gatandatu mu gitondo.
hear.close: Reba icyo itakoze: ntiyemeje ibyo itashoboraga kwemeza. Iyo Subiza itazi, irabivuga kandi ikakuzana. Igisubizo cy'ikinyoma gitwara ubucuruzi bwawe kurusha igisubizo kibuze.

thursday.title: Ubu ni ho amafaranga yawe agenda.
thursday.lede: Ntabwo abakiriya bagenda kubera ko utagurisha neza. Bagenda kubera ko nta muntu wasubije.
thursday.label: Abakiriya b'igerageza — si urutonde rw'abakiriya.
thursday.w1: 19:14 · yabwiwe amasaha, yasabye kuza ku wa gatandatu
thursday.w2: 12:40 · yabwiwe igiciro cyo mu rutonde rwawe

who.title: Niba uyu ari uwawe wa gatandatu, iki ni cyo gicuruzwa.
who.lede: Ibiciro bitandukanya ubwoko bw'ubucuruzi. Dore icyo buri umwe yumva.
who.salonBody: Amasaha, ibiciro, n'igice cyo ku wa gatandatu. Isubiza ibyo ishobora ikaguhamagara ku bindi.
who.clinicBody: Umurongo, ameza, icuma. Izi icyo ishobora gusezeranya n'icyo iguhamagara.
who.hotelBody: Abantu benshi ku rutonde. Isubiza uko amabwiriza yawe abivuga, ntabwo ihanga.

code.eyebrow: Nta munyabwenge. Nta telefone nshya. Kode imwe.
code.title: Kode ya telefone imaze kubaho kuva {year}.
code.lede: Tuguha kode, hanyuma duhamagare nomero yawe kugira ngo tugenzure ko yakoze. Ntidushobora kuyikanda mu mwanya wawe — telefone ifite SIM ni yo yonyine ishobora, kandi sosiyete iyo ari yo yose ibikubwira ibindi ivuga ikindi kintu.

channels.title: Ijwi rirakora. Ibindi bifite isaha tudashobora kugabanya.
channels.lede: Ubwenge bushobora kuvuga kuri telefone uyu munsi. Ubutumwa buzaza iyo platforme zarangije izigenzura zazo.
channels.phoneDetail: Birakora uyu munsi, kuri nomero yawe
channels.waDetail: Kwemezwa na Meta: iminsi y'akazi. Si uwo munsi.
channels.webDetail: Ku rupapuro rwawe, nyuma y'inzira ya telefone.
channels.notesDetail: Yumvwa, ntabwo yakekwa. Umuntu asuzuma ibidasobanutse.

kinya.title: Ikinyarwanda ntabwo ari icyongerwaho.
kinya.lede: Ibikoresho byinshi byubakwa mu Cyongereza hanyuma bikahindurwa. Twatangiye ku majwi ya telefone, mu iduka nyacyo.
kinya.unique: Nta sosiyete yabonetse ikora igicuruzwa cyuzuye, umucuruzi yikoresha wenyine, ku giciro cy'ubucuruzi buto, gisubiza amasimu mu Kinyarwanda.

compare.title: Dushingiye ku mushahara wo mu Rwanda, si ku giciro cy'undi.
compare.lede: Uwakira abantu n'uwunganira bakiriya bafite imishahara izwi i Kigali. Subiza ni umurongo wa gatatu kuri iyo ngingo.
compare.stopThem: Igihe cyo gutegereza, n'umuntu ushaka akandi kazi
compare.nothingBody: Ni ho ukwiriye kugereranya. Amasimu y'ijoro ntagira kuwa mbere.

report.title: Icyo icyumweru cyawe gitera.
report.lede: Ubutumwa bwa WhatsApp, mu rurimi rwawe. Igerageza — ni ishusho, si icyumweru cy'umukiriya.
report.name: Aline
report.weakness: Ku wa gatandatu mu gitondo ni ho habura — abantu batatu basabye igihe utarashyize ahagaragara.

wrong.title: Subiza ntabwo ikwiriye niba…
wrong.lede: Kuvuga oya birahendutse kurusha igerageza ritetse.
wrong.w1: Ukeneye ko dukanda kode yo kohereza mu mwanya wawe. Ntidushobora. Ni SIM ivugana n'operateri.
wrong.w2: Ukeneye WhatsApp uwo munsi wiyandikishije. Isaha ya Meta si iyacu.
wrong.w3: Ushaka ubushobozi bwo ​​guhamagara benshi icyarimwe. Ntitubikora.
wrong.w4: Ushaka umufasha rusange. Ubwenge busubiza ubucuruzi bwawe, si interineti yose.
wrong.w5: Ushaka uruta rw'ibirango mbere yo kugerageza nomero. Nomero ni yo kimwe.

faq.title: Ibyo abantu babaza koko.
faq.a1: Yego, kuko tubibabwira. Subiza itangira ivuga ko ari umufasha wa mudasobwa. Ntabwo tugerageza guhisha ibyo — kandi mu byukuri abakiriya benshi ntibibabaza, ahubwo ikibabaza ni ukutabona igisubizo na gato.
faq.q2: Bite se nivuga ikintu kitari cyo?
faq.a2: Subiza isubiza gusa ibyo wayibwiye. Nta kintu ihanga. Iyo ikibazo kirenze ibyo izi, ntikeka — irabivuga ikakuzana. Ubona kandi urutonde rw'ibibazo byose itashoboye gusubiza.
faq.a3: Oya. Nomero yawe ntihinduka na gato — nta kwimura, nta SIM nshya, nta telefone nshya. Ushobora kuyihagarika ukoresheje ##61# igihe icyo ari cyo cyose.
faq.a4: Telefone yawe ivuza, nk'uko byahoze mbere ya Subiza. Subiza ntigomba na rimwe gutuma ubucuruzi bwawe bugorana kugerwaho kurusha uko byari bimeze mbere.
faq.a5: Tugambiriye kubika amakuru bwite mu Rwanda, nk'uko ingingo ya 50 y'itegeko nº 058/2021 ribisaba. Ibyo biracyasuzumwa n'abanyamategeko — politiki y'ibanga ni yo mvugo ikora. Amajwi ntafatwa keretse ubyemeye.
faq.a6: Yego, ukoresheje kode imwe, ako kanya, utabanje kutubaza. Nta masezerano y'igihe kirekire, nta karita, nta kwishyura buri kwezi bigoye ​​guhagarika.
faq.a7: Kode zo kohereza ​​guhamagara ni izisanzwe kuva {year}. Turacyagenzura uko zikora kuri MTN na Airtel mu Rwanda, harimo n'uko nomero y'uhamagaye iguma n'igiciro cy'iyo nzira. Ntitubuze kuvuga ko bikora kugeza icyo gipimo cyanditswe.

pilot.title: Turi mu igerageza. Urashobora gusaba.
pilot.lede: Nta rutonde rw'ibirango. Dufite nomero ushobora ​​guhamagara, n'urutonde twuzuzuza n'ubucuruzi dushobora ​​guhura i Kigali.
pilot.partial: Ibisubizo byapimwe ntibirasohoka. Iyo bibayeho bizashyirwa hano, n'inkomoko yabyo.
pilot.applyBody: Tubwire ubucuruzi n'inomero abakiriya bakoresha. Dusubiza kuri WhatsApp mu masaha y'abantu.

final.title: Umenye ijwi mbere yo kwiyandikisha.
final.lede: Inzira eshatu. Telefone nta konti nta JavaScript ikenewe.

how.title: Nta bumaji. Kode ya telefone imaze kubaho kuva {year}.
how.lede: Iyi paji isobanura buri ntambwe, kugira ngo umenye neza icyo wemera mbere yo gutangira.
how.s1b: Hari uburyo bubiri gusa, kandi ubwa mbere ni bwo dusaba. Iyo utitabye gusa — telefone yawe ivuza amasegonda 20 mbere. Cyangwa buri ​​guhamagara kose.
how.s2: 2. Ukanda kode kuri telefone ifite SIM
how.s2b: Turayikwereka, tunayikwandukurire. Icyo tudashobora ni ukuyikanda mu mwanya wawe.
how.s3: 3. Turahamagara nomero yawe kugira ngo tugenzure
how.s3b: Ntitwizera ko byakoze; turabigenzura. Kandi tubisubiramo buri cyumweru.
how.s4b: Amasaha, aho uherereye, ibiciro, ururimi, ijwi, n'imipaka.
how.s5b: Iyo umukiriya akeneye umuntu, Subiza iraguhamagara — telefone ivuza.
how.breakLede: Ntabwo duhagarara. Tugabanya serivisi buhoro buhoro, kandi ku mpera, telefone yawe iravuza.
how.r4d: Nk'uko byari bimeze mbere ya Subiza
how.promiseBody: Subiza ntigomba na rimwe gutuma ubucuruzi bwawe bugorana kugerwaho kurusha uko byari bimeze mbere yayo.
how.heading: Kanda iyi kode
how.plat: Kuri Android gusa. Ifungura dialler ariko ntihamagara. Kuri iPhone tuguha intambwe zo gukoporora.

pricing.title: Amafaranga y'imbere, muri RWF, na MoMo.
pricing.lede: Nk'uko ugura airtime. Nta karita, nta masezerano, nta fagitire itunguranye.
pricing.bannerTitle: Soma ibi mbere: ibi ni ibiciro by'igerageza
pricing.bannerBody: Ntituramenya neza umubare w'iminota ubucuruzi bukoresha ku kwezi — ni cyo kintu cy'ingenzi kuruta ibindi mu bukungu bwacu, kandi turacyagipima. Ibiciro biri hasi ni ukuri ku bagerageza bose muri uyu mwaka, ariko bishobora ​​guhinduka mbere yo gutangira kuri bose.
pricing.homeBannerBody: Turacyapima umubare w'iminota ubucuruzi nyabwo bukoresha ku kwezi. Ntitwifuza gushyiraho igiciro tutabasha gukomeza.
pricing.b1c: Raporo ya buri cyumweru kuri WhatsApp
pricing.b3c: Tuvugane ku bwinshi. Ntabwo turi urubuga rw'abanyabwenge.
pricing.momoBody: Wemeza kuri telefone yawe. Ntidushobora kuvana amafaranga kuri konti yawe udatanze uruhushya.
pricing.billBody: Amafaranga ni ay'imbere. Tukumenyesha inshuro ebyiri amafaranga agabanuka.
pricing.zeroBody: Ntabwo ubucuruzi bwawe buceceka. Guhamagara bigaruka kuri telefone yawe.
pricing.setupWhy: Ni kode imwe. Kuyishyiraho ku giciro ni ugukuraho ikizere.
pricing.exportWhy: Ibiganiro byawe ni ibyawe, mu buryo bwa CSV, igihe cyose.

security.title: Aho amakuru abikwa, n'ushobora ​​kuyareba.
security.lede: Paji rusange, kuko itegeko 058/2021 ntabwo ari ihuziriro.
security.residencyBody: Tugambiriye kubika amakuru bwite mu Rwanda, nk'uko ingingo ya 50 ibisaba. Icyiciro cya mbere gikoresha zimwe muri API zo hanze, kandi abanyamategeko ntibarinnyuzemo. Kugeza icyo cyanditswe, ubwihisho ni isezerano turimo kubaka, si ukuri kurangije.
security.ncsaBody: Nomero izashyirwa hano iyo ibayeho. Gutegereza biragaragara ku gukunda.
security.accessBody: Igihe cyihutirwa gusa, kimenyeshejwe, kandi gisuzumwa.
security.retentionBody: Inyandiko zibikwa umwaka, ushobora ​​kugabanya. Amajwi ntafatwa keretse ubyemeye.
security.subBody: Bazandikwa hano iyo bemerewe. Nta «n'abandi» bihishe.
security.breachBody: Tumenyesha ubuyobozi n'abagize icyo ikosa gikorerwa mu gihe itegeko rishyizeho.
security.hostBody: Niba ibikorwa byo hanze bitemerewe, kwibika byihuta. Icyo cyemezo kiri mu bibazo bigifunguye.

about.title: Subiza bisobanura «subiza».
about.lede: Ni inshinga y'Ikinyarwanda — gusubiza. Naho izina igisubizo risobanura icyarimwe igisubizo n'umuti w'ikibazo.
about.notice1: Ubucuruzi buto ntibutakaza abakiriya kubera ibicuruzwa bibi. Butakaza abakiriya kubera ko nta muntu wasubije.
about.notice2: Rwanda ifite ubucuruzi {enterprises}. Bene umunani muri icyo icumi bafite abakozi umwe kugeza kuri batatu.
about.b1b: Ibikoresho byinshi bya AI bikorerwa mu Cyongereza. Twatangiye ku rundi ruhande.
about.b2b: Igisubizo cy'ikinyoma gitwara ubucuruzi bwawe kurusha igisubizo kibuze.
about.b3: Ntabwo twigera duhindura ubucuruzi bwawe ikitageraho.
about.b3b: Nubwo byose byanaba binaniwe, telefone yawe iravuza.
about.b4b: Meta isaba iminsi y'akazi. Ntidushobora gushyiraho kode mu mwanya wawe. Ibiciro biracyapimwa.
about.whereBody: Turi mu igerageza i Kigali. Nta bakiriya ibihumbi. Nta birango by'amasosiyete akomeye. Ikintu cyonyine dushobora kukwereka ni ubwenge ubwabwo.
about.teamBody: Twatangiriye i Kigali. Amazina n'amateka y'abashinze azashyirwa hano mbere yo gutangira kuri bose.
about.address: Umujyi wa Kigali, u Rwanda. Aderesi yuzuye izashyirwaho mbere yo gutangira kuri bose.
about.name: Izina
about.nameBody: Twasuzumye andi mazina. Subiza ryatsinze kuko risobanura igicuruzwa cyose mu ijambo rimwe, mu rurimi rw'isoko rya mbere.

contact.title: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp. Ni ho tuba.
contact.lede: Ifishi irahari. WhatsApp iracyihuta mu masaha y'abantu.
contact.callBody: Subiza ubwayo isubiza — ni na yo demo. Nyuma y'amasaha, iyo nomero ni ubwenge — umuntu asubiza mu gitondo gikurikira.
contact.dataBody: Kugira ngo usabe, ukosore cyangwa usibe amakuru yawe, twandikire DPO cyangwa ukoreshe ifishi. Dusubiza mu gihe itegeko rishyizeho.
contact.hoursNote: Igicuruzwa gisubiza amasaha 24 kandi abantu bacyo bakora mu masaha y'akazi kigomba kuvuga icyabaho saa 15: iyo nomero iracyasubiza; umuntu afata ikibazo mu gitondo gikurikira.
contact.name: Izina ryawe
contact.sent: Byakiriwe. Tuzasubiza mu masaha y'abantu, cyangwa mu gitondo gikurikira niba wanditse nyuma ya {end}.

legal.title: Icyo dukora ku makuru, mu magambo asobanutse.
legal.lede: Inyandiko zuzuye ziri hano. Iyi ncamake ni yo mvugo nyayo.
legal.livesBody: Tugambiriye kubika amakuru bwite mu Rwanda, nk'uko ingingo ya 50 ibisaba. Iyo igice gisaba koherezwa hanze, tubanza ​​gusaba uruhushya.
legal.access: Kubona — twandikire, tukoherereze ibyo dufite kuri wowe mu minsi mirongo itatu
legal.correction: Gukosora — ikosa rikosorwa mu minsi mirongo itatu
legal.deletion: Gusiba — ushobora ​​gusiba ikiganiro kimwe, cyangwa konti yose
legal.port: Kwimura — ibiganiro byawe muri CSV, ubuntu, igihe cyose
legal.n1: Ntitugurisha amakuru y'abakiriya bawe. Na rimwe.
legal.n2: Ntitwohereza ubutumwa bwo kwamamaza ku bantu bahamagaye ubucuruzi bwawe.
legal.n3: Ntidukoresha ibiganiro byawe kwigisha imashini rusange keretse ubyemeye ukwacyo.
legal.aiBody: Buri kiganiro Subiza itangira, ivuga ko ari umufasha wa mudasobwa, mu rurimi rw'uhamagaye. Ntibishoboka kubihagarika.
legal.aiNote: Ni itegeko riri kuza mu masoko menshi, ariko ni na cyo cyemezo cyacu.
legal.dpoBody: Ni itegeko ko iyi aderesi igaragara ku mugaragaro. Iyi ni yo.
legal.a11yBody: Uru rubuga rwubatswe ku ncungamiterere WCAG 2.2 AA. Umwanya n'ukunyeganyega bihindurwa mu mutwe. Niba hari ikintu kidakoreshwa, andikira muraho@subiza.rw — tubifata nk'ikosa.

data.sent: Byakiriwe. Tuzasubiza kuri nomero cyangwa imeyili watanze.

auth.sumSell: Ntitugurisha amakuru y'abakiriya bawe, kandi ntitwigisha imashini rusange tubikoresheje.
auth.sumWithdraw: Ushobora kubyikuramo igihe icyo ari cyo cyose, kandi bikaba byoroshye nk'uko byari byoroshye kubyemera.
auth.contractTitle: Nemeye amasezerano n'amasezerano yo gutunganya amakuru
auth.contractLede: Ibi ni byo bituma konti ibaho. Nta bundi buryo bwo gukoresha Subiza.
auth.marketTitle: Munyoherereze inama n'amakuru mashya kuri WhatsApp
auth.marketLede: Byihariye kandi bitandukanye. Konti yawe ikora neza nutabyemeye, kandi ushobora kubireka wandika STOP.
auth.notOnThisPage: Ibi ntibiri kuri iyi paji ku bushake: kwemera gufata amajwi, no kwemera gukoresha ijwi ry'umuntu.
auth.doneLede: Ubutaha: kuvuza telefone yawe. Ntabwo ari ukwiyandikisha — ni ukumva umufasha wawe abanza kuvuga.
auth.activateLede: Gushyira mu bikorwa bitangira hano. Icyambere ni ukumva umufasha wawe asubiza — guhuza umurongo biza nyuma.
auth.chooseLede: Iyi nomero ikora ku bucuruzi burenze bumwe. Umuntu ashobora kuba mu bucuruzi burenze bumwe.
auth.chooseMissing: Nta bundi bucuruzi ubonye? Saba nyirabwo kuguhamagara.
auth.blockedBody: Ongera ugerageze mu minota mike. Ntabwo ari ikosa ryawe — ni uburyo turinda nomero yawe.
auth.blockedLede: Niba ubwihutirwe, twandikire kuri WhatsApp kandi umuntu azagufasha.
auth.recycledTitle: Iyi nomero ishobora kuba yahinduwe nyirayo
auth.recycledLede: Dukeneye umuntu ngo asuzume mbere yuko umuntu abona inbox. Ntituzavuga izina ry'ubucuruzi hano.
auth.recoverLede: Nomero yawe ni yo konti yawe. Bityo icyo ukora biterwa n'icyabaye kuri nomero.
auth.recDelivery: Nkiri kuri nomero, ariko kode ntiraza
auth.recDeliveryLede: Ubwa mbere ni ho ikibazo kiba
auth.recLostLede: Ushobora kongera kuyibona kuri MTN cyangwa Airtel
auth.recDisputeLede: Abantu babiri muri Subiza basuzuma ibi, n'ibimenyetso by'ubucuruzi
auth.tryOtherLede: SMS zishobora gutinda cyangwa gutakara. Ntibisobanura ko konti yawe ifite ikibazo.
auth.waNet: Inyura ku interineti, si ku murongo wa SMS
auth.getNumberLede: MTN na Airtel bagusimbura SIM ubereka indangamuntu. Nyuma yo kuyibona, konti yawe ihita igaruka.
auth.takeWithBody: Indangamuntu ihuye n'iyanditse kuri SIM. Ni ko byifashe no kuri MoMo.
auth.humanLede: Nta buryo bwa mudasobwa bwo ​​guhindura nomero konti irimo. Ni na cyo kirinda ubucuruzi bwawe.
auth.askRdb: Icyemezo cy'ubucuruzi cya RDB, niba ubufite
auth.askMomo: Kwishyura kwa MoMo ku kirahure cyishyuye iyi konti
auth.humanFoot: Bisubizwa mu masaha 24 y'akazi. Mu gihe cyose, ihamagara ryawe rikomeza kugera kuri telefone yawe.
auth.recSentLede: Ntituzakubaza kode. Nta muntu wo muri Subiza uzigera aguhamagara akugusaba kode. Niba hari uwabikora, si twe.
auth.asideWhy1: Ni yo abakiriya bawe basanzwe bakoresha.
auth.asideWhy2: Ni yo MoMo ikoresha — nta karita ikenewe.
auth.asideTwoMinBody: Ibibazo bitanu. Nta kimwe muri byo kidakenewe koko.
auth.asideCodeTitle: Kuki kode rimwe na rimwe itinda
auth.asideCodeBody: SMS zinyura ku murongo wa telefone. Ni yo mpamvu WhatsApp na telefone biri hano — si ibisubizo bya nyuma.
auth.asideCaptchaBody: Turwanya ibikorwa by'ubujura inyuma — tugereranya kode zoherejwe n'izemejwe, tukemera nomero z'u Rwanda gusa.
auth.asideHear: Ibi ni byo abakiriya bawe bazumva
auth.asideLangBody: Itegeko nº 058/2021 risaba ko kwemera kuba kuzi neza. Kwemera inyandiko mu rurimi utumva neza si ukwemera kuzi.
auth.asideRwBody: Si igisubizo cya nyuma. Ni cyo cyubatswe mbere, kandi ni cyo umufasha atangiraho.
auth.asideTwoTitle: Kuki ari ibyemezo bibiri, atari kimwe
auth.asideTwoBody: Kwemera kumwe guhuriza hamwe impamvu zitandukanye ntikwemewe. Amasezerano ni ngombwa; kwamamaza ni ugushaka kwawe.
auth.asideNextBody: Telefone yawe igiye kuvuza. Uzumva umufasha wawe mbere yuko umukiriya awumva.
auth.asideRecBody: Nomero ni yo konti. Nta imeyili, nta jambobanga byo kugusubiza. Igihe ni cyo kugenzura.
auth.asideNeverBody: Nta muntu wo muri Subiza uzigera aguhamagara akugusaba kode. Kode ni iyawe wenyine.
